claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_ac_set_base (multi-ability)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ModifyAcSetBaseEffect currently accepts a single `abilityMod: Ability`. Barbarian Unarmored Defense requires base AC = 10 + DEX mod + CON mod — two distinct ability modifiers summed together. The existing single-modifier shape cannot express this without omitting CON, which would be a dishonest trace. Widening `abilityMod` to `ReadonlyNonEmptyArray<Ability>` (or adding a second optional `secondAbilityMod?: Ability`) would resolve this without a new atom or new family. The same widening would cover Monk Unarmored Defense (10 + DEX + WIS) from a single shape.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Constitution modifiers
